messages:
maya: FYI discovered a docs build failure in staging — looks like a bunch of code snippets still use the v1 models endpoint. I opened a quick PR but want coordination before merging.

sam: ack, do we have a failing CI link? can you paste the error?

maya: here: https://staging-docs.redwood/ops/build/4567 — snippet-checker complains: `snippet-check: mismatch: 'v1/models' found`

docs-bot: Automated note: docs linter detected 5 occurrences of deprecated endpoints in `examples/` folder. See report: https://reports.docs.redwood/4567/snippet-report

julian: thanks. is the PR just a find/replace or are any snippets using the old `client.models.generate(...)` shape?

maya: mixed. Some snippets are simple replacement, others need param rename and new streaming example. Example that needs hand-edit: 
```js
// old
const res = await client.models.generate({ model: 'open-v1', prompt });
// new API expects: client.responses.create({ model: 'open-v2', input: prompt })
```

eli: @maya can you mark the snippets that require logic change? I can take the streaming update.

maya: done — added inline comments in the PR with `/// REVIEW: streaming` tags on three files. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/982

sam: CI also failed on the snippets smoke test for auth examples — uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` variant that our SDK renamed to `REDWOOD_KEY`. small change but might break copy-paste for customers. We should add a migration note.

julian: agree. propose the doc change flow: (1) update simple snippets in bulk, (2) hand-edit streaming/auth ones, (3) run local snippet-checker and a full docs build, (4) add migration callout at top of v1->v2 migration guide. Any objections?

eli: sounds good. timeline?

maya: I can do the bulk replacements today. eli you said you'll handle streaming — want to pair?

eli: yes— I'll take the streaming ones and one auth example. pairing at 3pm PT.

sam: I'll add a short migration callout and an 'If you see X' troubleshooting bullet to the migration guide. Will open a separate PR and link to yours.

julian: can backend-ci run a targeted snippet smoke test after PR merge? currently runs overnight only.

backend-ci: scheduled job run requested by julian: triggered `docs/snippet-smoke` for PR 982 — started, ETA ~10m.

maya: thanks — also note: please avoid changing copy examples in the tutorials folder unless behavior is identical. We want minimal friction for beginners.

sam: good note. I'll only add explicit migration notes, no behavior changes.

eli: small question — when we swap model names in examples should we point to the model alias map? I can add a footnote with alias table.

julian: yes include alias table and link to /docs/models/aliases. Also add a test checklist comment at top of each changed page: `// TEST: run snippet-check && local build && smoke linkcheck`

maya: PR 982 updated with checklist and comments. backend-ci smoke run passed initial checks but found one remaining auth env var in `tutorials/getting-started.md` line 42.

sam: I'll patch that tiny line in a follow-up; no need to block the main PR. open small PR and tag for fastmerge.

maya: thanks all. owners: maya (bulk), eli (streaming/auth), sam (migration note + quick patch), julian (final review + merge). We'll wait for backend-ci full run and then merge by EOD if green. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Reminder: update CHANGELOG entry `docs: migration guide snippets updated` — created draft at /changelog/2026-03-21.md

julian: perfect. if anything blocks CI ping #eng-oncall and I'll kick it.

maya: will do. closing thread here once PR merged.
